take: EDM announced it placed Ryan Nugent-Hopkins on injured reserve, placed Alec Regula on long-term injured reserve and recalled Josh Samanski under emergency conditions. Nugent-Hopkins has played 19.95 minutes a night, mostly on the second line and the first power-play unit, so Owen Michaels (12:49 a night) is next in line for his minutes and Kasperi Kapanen is the likeliest to move up on the power play. Samanski has averaged 7.73 minutes in six games, so this is a much smaller role. The Oilers are 8-2-1, and their even-strength expected goal share is 49%.
